summary.en: The sheets slide off and an index card is dealt on; every claim of the film is entered one a beat, each with its exhibit tab pressed and its source.
summary.zh: 纸张滑走，一张索引卡发上来；片子里的每条断言每拍记入一行，各自压上证物标签，并注明出处。

fits: A recap before the name: every claim and where it came from.
notFor: films with one exhibit; more than six claims.

intent.en: Close the file: the viewer sees every claim again, each tied to its source.
intent.zh: 合上卷宗：观众再看一遍每条断言，各自连着出处。

content.en: A claim in 1–2 phrases and 2–6 rows (exhibit number, the claim ≤ 36 chars, its source).
content.zh: 1–2 段断言和 2–6 行（证物编号、断言 ≤ 16 字、出处）。

fits.zh: 报名字前的回顾：每条断言和它的出处。

notFor.zh: 只有一份证物的片子；超过六条断言。

en: Restate claims the film struck; no new ones here.
zh: 只复述片子里划过的断言；这里不加新的。

source.path: the dossier source film planOf ledger; film.js buildLedger, paintLedger; layout.js ledgerBox

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
